core_principles: Color is function. 95% monochrome with highly intentional accent colors.
Tension over harmony. Asymmetry and harsh contrast replace safe AI templates.
The OS is the brain. Utilitarian, modular, raw structures with exposed borders.
anti_patterns: No Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter text-foreground
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight text-foreground

spacing_and_layout.containers: border-collapse style layout, sharp edges, 1px solid borders.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous internal padding for cards (p-6 or p-8).

components.buttons: Square edges, solid primary color or transparent with 1px black border. High contrast text.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border-[#18181B], no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and sharp black shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#000]).
components.voice_recorder: Large, immersive button (Safe Zone enabled) with solid primary color. Z-axis 3D waveform or visual breath ring. Real-time mono-spaced captions below it.
components.workflow_boards: Kanban style but brutalist. Exposed borders. Background white, columns separated by 1px solid border. No gaps between columns.
components.chat_interface: Command-line aesthetic for 'Ask AI'. Monospace inputs, system-like prompt prefixes (>) instead of chat bubbles.
shadcn_overrides: Replace soft box-shadows with hard 1px borders or solid offset shadows.
Use IBM Plex Mono for form inputs and table cells.

motion.philosophy: Micro-interactions for feedback only. Snappy, mechanical.
motion.voice_active: Pulse animation for recording state, dynamic scaling for waveform.

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight (no duotone or light for brutalist theme).

images.description: Background noise for active voice recording state or brutalist accents

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based. Examples: data-testid='voice-record-button', data-testid='approve-task-button', data-testid='owner-inbox-tab'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Chivo' and 'IBM Plex Mono' via index.css or index.html.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the specified custom colors, font families, and extend box-shadow for the brutalist shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#000] effect.
Build the dashboard using pure HTML/Tailwind for the structural grid. Use Shadcn components for complex interactive elements (Dialog, Select, Tabs).
CRITICAL: Strip out any rounded corners from Shadcn components using 'rounded-none'. Replace any soft shadows with 1px black borders.
Implement the 'Voice-first owner inbox' with the brutalist aesthetic: high-contrast recording button, real-time mono-spaced captions.
Ensure all components use the '.js' extension instead of '.tsx' since this environment requires JavaScript.
For the 'Company Brain' and 'Ask AI' interfaces, implement a clean, data-dense layout using 'IBM Plex Mono' to evoke a command-center/technical feel.
Ensure ALL interactive items (buttons, inputs, workflow cards) have data-testid attributes for testing.
